Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

holiday — a day or period of celebration or rest. Example: The holiday is in spring.
festival — a public celebration. Example: The big festival is in spring.
tradition — a custom that continues for years. Example: It is a tradition to give gifts.
family — parents, children and relatives. Example: My family eats together.
food — what people eat. Example: I bring some food.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• In my country ...
• My family eats together.
• It is a tradition to ...
• The festival is in ...
• We visit my grandparents.
